method: Native Windows app interaction through the computer-use skill; observed rendered screenshots after each action.
checks: MB01.3mf loads with the regenerated prime volume of 1 mm3 and no invalid-setting error.
Multimaterial settings display the material-band engine, boundary policy, width, dose allowance, comma-separated envelope and stationary tool selection declaration without the former TextCtrl crash.
Native Slice plate completes using Planning material bands and shows MB_CYCLE / MB_BEAD / MB_OPERATION in the G-code view.
MB01 preview displays 10 logical cycles, top 2.40 mm, two physical filament colors and 19 tool changes.
Dragging the upper cycle slider to 5 displays 1.20 mm and filters the visible geometry and operation range.
MB01 deposited-height mode shows 0.12 mm; line-width mode shows 0.44 and 0.45 mm bins.
MB02-transition.3mf reload preserves two virtual mixes, Allow transition, 2 mm width and 25 percent dose allowance.
Native slicing of MB02-transition completes and displays 10 logical cycles at 2.40 mm despite varying extrusion Z.
Transition deposited-height legend spans 0.06 through 0.24 mm, including the pure-material interior.
The verification app was closed after inspection; no print or upload was initiated.
fixed_findings: An empty coFloats default crashed TextCtrl::BUILD and its numeric list UI could not edit the full envelope. The setting now uses coString with bounded strict numeric parsing.
The original demo prime volume of 0.5 mm3 violated the existing GUI minimum; numerical fixture profiles now use 1 mm3.
subsequent_change: After native inspection, the engine lookup in GCode::append_full_config was hoisted out of the per-key loop. UI and preview sources did not change. Both builds, the complete CTest selection and production/export tests passed again (with the same eight baseline CTest failures).
